class.name: OcgShapebuildEdge
class.brief_description: This class provides low-level operators for building an edge 3d curve, copying edge with replaced vertices etc.
class.description: ! This class provides low-level operators for building an edge ! 3d curve, copying edge with replaced vertices etc.

method.name: CopyReplaceVertices
method.description: Copy edge and replace one or both its vertices to a given one(s). Vertex V1 replaces FORWARD vertex, and V2 - REVERSED, as they are found by TopoDS_Iterator. If V1 or V2 is NULL, the original vertex is taken

method.name: CopyRanges
method.description: Copies ranges for curve3d and all common pcurves from edge <fromedge> into edge <toedge>.

method.name: CopyPCurves
method.description: Makes a copy of pcurves from edge <fromedge> into edge <toedge>. Pcurves which are already present in <toedge>, are replaced by copies, other are copied. Ranges are also copied.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Make a copy of <edge> by call to CopyReplaceVertices() (i.e. construct new TEdge with the same pcurves and vertices). If <sharepcurves> is False, pcurves are also replaced by their copies with help of method CopyPCurves

method.name: RemovePCurve_1
method.description: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Face

method.name: RemovePCurve_2
method.description: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Surface

method.name: RemovePCurve_3
method.description: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Surface, with given Location

method.name: ReplacePCurve
method.description: Replace the PCurve in an Edge for the given Face In case if edge is seam, i.e. has 2 pcurves on that face, only pcurve corresponding to the orientation of the edge is replaced

method.name: ReassignPCurve
method.description: Reassign edge pcurve lying on face <old> to another face . If edge has two pcurves on <old> face, only one of them will be reassigned, and other will left alone. Similarly, if edge already had a pcurve on face , it will have two pcurves on it. Returns True if succeeded, False if no pcurve lying on <old> found.

method.name: TransformPCurve
method.description: Transforms the PCurve with given matrix and affinity U factor.

method.name: RemoveCurve3d
method.description: Removes the Curve3D recorded in an Edge

method.name: MakeEdge_1
method.description: Makes edge with curve and location

method.name: MakeEdge_4
method.description: Makes edge with curve, location and range [p1, p2]

method.name: MakeEdge_2
method.description: Makes edge with pcurve and face

method.name: MakeEdge_5
method.description: Makes edge with pcurve, face and range [p1, p2]

method.name: MakeEdge_3
method.description: Makes edge with pcurve, surface and location

method.name: MakeEdge_6
method.description: Makes edge with pcurve, surface, location and range [p1, p2]
